cat /inputs/request.md; echo '
---catalog---'; cat /inputs/tool-catalog.json; echo '
---selection---'; cat /inputs/selection.json; echo '
---index---'; cat /inputs/index-slice.json

python - <<'PY'
import json
c=json.load(open('/inputs/tool-catalog.json'));print(json.dumps([t for t in c['tools'] if t['id']=='runtime.move'],indent=2));print('SELECTION',json.dumps(json.load(open('/inputs/selection.json')),indent=2));
PY
ls -la /outputs; ls /work/docs/studio/schemas/change-set.schema.json 2>/dev/null || true

pwd; find /work -path '*change-set.schema.json' -print | head; python - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('/inputs/selection.json'));t=s['targets'][0]
o={'id':'cs_01M4CD0Y6ZHX918HZ9VRA61SSJ','schema':'gamecore.studio.changeset/1','intent':{'text':'Move only the selected live Bram instance in the running GameCore world, not authored content, to absolute world position [11.5,0.0,-13.0] and yaw 270 degrees.','origin':'agent'},'selection':s,'baseVersions':[{'ref':t,'stamp':t['stamp']}],'operations':[{'opId':'op1','tool':'runtime.move','target':t,'args':{'position':[11.5,0.0,-13.0],'yaw':270.0},'dependsOn':[],'preconditions':'stamp','applyRequirement':'Live'}],'artifacts':[],'requirements':{'max':'Live','worldRebuild':False,'compile':False,'build':False}}
with open('/outputs/changeset.json','w') as f:json.dump(o,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('verified',len(o['operations']),o['operations'][0]['target']==s['targets'][0],o['selection']==s)
PY
python -m json.tool /outputs/changeset.json >/dev/null && cat /outputs/changeset.json
